title: DLR lithium-graphite cell GITT and quasi-open-circuit measurements
domain: battery diagnostics and laboratory data integration
question: How do charge history and operating conditions relate to battery response within this half-cell?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Clark, Simon (SINTEF); Tolchard, Julian (SINTEF Industry); Kopljar, Dennis (German Aerospace Center); Schmitt, Christina (German Aerospace Center); Barbers, Elias (Forschungszentrum Jülich)
measurement_dates: Basytec headers: GITT 2022-11-14 10:40:01 to 2022-12-10 02:27:48; POCV 2023-01-31 19:39:26 to 2023-02-06 18:20:34. Both exports were converted by source software on 2025-09-05; repository publication 2025-10-08.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Complete cycle and operating blocks within one cell.
validation_design: Complete cycle and operating blocks within one cell. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Original laboratory battery-cycler exports. The broader source record includes files explicitly labeled with time/outlier bugs for pipeline testing; those are not selected. Full metadata describes both selected and omitted files.
prior_analysis_and_limits: This DLR record was released for battery data-pipeline and workflow testing. GITT and POCV belong to the same cell at different times and are not independent cells. The metadata includes other laboratories/files not present in this coherent subset. Absolute state of charge and history depend on source protocol and capacity definitions. DLR native exports; one half-cell limits cross-cell generalization. Source processing/format details preserved.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.

eligibility.novelty: no unseen-law guarantee; independent adjudication required

exposure: Open source-aware; source literature and supplied analyses accessible
unit_interpretation: Use exact source field/sheet/channel labels and units in source_evidence and per-file reports; unknown units remain unresolved, not inferred from a variable name.
